title: Central Government must establish Central Authority
description: Establishment of Central Consumer Protection Authority

content.what: shall establish a Central Consumer Protection Authority
conditions: with effect from such date as it may specify in that notification
limitations: to regulate matters relating to violation of rights of consumers, unfair trade practices and false or misleading advertisements which are prejudicial to the interests of public and consumers
to promote, protect and enforce the rights of consumers as a class
